grounded.observation: Bassy Q16.16 decimals for fractional action coordinates, integer snapshot tiles and IDs; six inventory slots; shared public hero draft.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.low_health_in_field: Below 30% health outside the friendly keep/spawn, alive and not channeling/stunned. Recovery takes priority over farming and attack reacquisition.
predicates.low_health_in_base: Critical health inside own keep/spawn commits to walking and replenishment without a home portal.
predicates.active: Alive, battle started, decision due, not channeling or stunned
predicates.in_base: Host canShop identifies own keep or spawn; home recalls are disallowed here while useful outbound channels remain legal.
predicates.town_scroll_ready: Committed field recovery with an actual ready scroll; safe channel checks must still pass.
predicates.recovery_remaining: Recovery owns the decision and no successful channel/replenishment action has claimed it.

situation.notes: Coached home recall differs from outbound tower travel. in_base=canShop, fountain=inOwnSpawn. Public hero/creep separation and warnings gate a field channel. Global geometry and Crossbow draft are retained; current engine rejects ordinary commands during channels. Actual stun/root, anchor loss or death interrupts; a bot cannot cancel a channel by walking. Current item2 restores90HP instantly for75gold; item1 regenerates120 over10seconds and damage interrupts it. Health consumables share10second cooldown. Public observations only; no opponent identity features.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. The lifecycle binding explicitly resets initialization and retreat state after death.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unknown. Visible targets may be masked. Only the draft roster, allied positions and visible opponents inform live choices.

OpportunityMechanism.claim: All240 actual-tick item/healing/economy scenes pass across ten classes and both colors. Baseline separately satisfies240 expectations for its original behavior, including no immediate combat healing. Eight full native games pass runtime/replay/XP checks. This validates immediate healing, cooldown, spawn, inventory and reserve guards, not comparative rival score.

FieldDrift.claim: Opponent-version and game snapshots are evaluation metadata; newer entries can change optimal behavior. No opponent UUID or hidden replay state enters the live source. Changed game or principal champions prevent deployment; background changes are reported. Preserve exact tested-version scope.

Win.preference: No independent victory incentive. Enemy-god destruction supplies500 own XP and avoids later elapsed-time cost. Keep the baseline structure targeting in this experiment; do not idle merely to lengthen games.

Grow.preference: Earn shared XP and last-hit gold, spend legal skill points, and convert gold into durable combat strength.

Survive.preference: Avoid repeated feeding, recover efficiently, and promptly return to productive play.

Score.preference: Sole objective: maximize final individual max(0, lifetime XP*1440 -200*world_ticks)//1440. Hero kill150XP, shared creep pool15XP, building100XP, enemy god destruction500XP for every teammate. Prefer productive kills and farming; elapsed time always costs200/minute. Survival, items and portals matter only through their contribution to this objective.

Practice.preference: Secure feasible last hits and shared XP, buy useful permanent power, and use safe portals for urgent defense or productive recovery.

survive_and_replenish.preference: At critical field health, disengage and channel safely home before more farming; restore HP/mana at spawn and return productively with a reserved scroll.
